lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light pixels on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, discrete high-luminance blobs are distributed sparsely across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, appearing primarily in the central and posterior regions.

other_distinctive_markers: A strong caustic network of light, caused by surface refraction, is projected across the entire dorsal and lateral surface of the shark, creating a high-contrast web-like overlay.
